newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to grow 3.5 pct in '97- Central Bank chief.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to grow 3.5 pct in '97- Central Bank chief.

text.p: Ecuador's economy should grow by 3.5 percent in 1997 powered by the oil and farm sectors and the privatization of telephone firm Emetel, Central Bank chief Fidel Jaramillo said Thursday.

"It will be very difficult this year to get back to growth comparable to that of our neighbors Colombia and Peru, but we think it is reasonable to maintain the growth target of 3.5 percent," Jaramillo told foreign correspondents.

He said public and private investment should allow the oil sector to recover ground lost last year and that the economy should be growing again by the second half. Ecuador grew by 1.8 percent in 1996, and the government foresees expansion of four percent next year.
The sale of 35 percent of Emetel is due in the second half. The privatization was originally set for April but was postponed after the destitution of President Abdala Bucaram.
